choices.text: `gemm(N, N, M, N, K, A, lda=K, B, ldb=N, C, ldc=N)`: the call is the same in both layouts.
`gemm(T, T, M, N, K, A, lda=K, B, ldb=N, C, ldc=N)`: transpose both inputs.
`gemm(N, N, N, M, K, B, ldb=N, A, lda=K, C, ldc=N)`: swap the operands and `M` with `N`.
Not possible: you must transpose A and B into column-major first.
